hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: A point at coordinates (x, y) requires a square of minimum half-side size equal to max(|x|, |y|) to be enclosed.

hints.title: Duplicate Tag Conflict
hints.text: For each tag letter, find the smallest and second smallest half-side sizes among points bearing that tag.

hints.title: Global Radius Cutoff
hints.text: The maximum allowable square size is strictly less than the smallest second-minimum distance across all duplicated tags. Count all distinct tags whose first distance is strictly smaller than this threshold.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass updating primary and secondary minima across 26 characters.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Binary search on distance adds logarithmic overhead when linear filtering is direct.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that the critical conflict limit is determined by the minimum second occurrence distance.
